messages:
matt: Heads-up — mkdocs build failing on CI with a 404 for a relative link that used a different case. stack trace: 

deploy-bot: build failed for commit dc3a9 (docs-site) — https://ci.internal/redwood/build/3345 :warning:

matt: repro locally: run `mkdocs build` -> notice: WARNING - 404 page not found: 'guides/Config.md' even though file exists at docs/guides/config.md (lowercase)

elaine: ah classic. MkDocs is case-sensitive when running on our linux CI. Locally mac/osx sometimes hides it. :facepalm:

sophia: quick question — is this just one link or a bunch? can we script a fix?

matt: I grepped the repo: 
```
$ git grep -n "Guides/Config.md" || true
docs/README.md:42:See the deployment Guides/Config.md for details
docs/guides/setup.md:15:link -> ../Guides/Config.md
```
so two occurrences. one headline example in README and one relative link in setup.md

elaine: ok low-effort path: update the links to lowercase and escape the code sample in README. I can open a docs PR for this. Will also add a small test in mkdocs linkcheck step to catch case mismatch. :+1:

matt: thanks. For README snippet we should also wrap the inline path in backticks so mkdocs linkcheck doesn't try to resolve it as a real link in rendered md. example: `\`Guides/Config.md\`` -> `` `guides/config.md` ``

elaine: taking it. I'll put two commits: (1) fix the two links, (2) add a linkcheck exception rule and a tiny CI job: `scripts/check-link-case.sh`

sophia: if you want I can add a sed one-liner to bulk-fix similar cases in other docs. something like: 
```
git grep -Il "Guides/" docs | xargs sed -i 's#Guides/#guides/#g'
```
But will review first — might be noisy if other intended capitals exist.

deploy-bot: CI queued for branch docs/pathcase-fix by elaine — build 3346

matt: also watch for inline code blocks that include paths inside triple backticks; mkdocs will treat those as code not links. But inline bare paths without backticks get linkified in some renderers. Worth escaping.

elaine: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/1289 — title: docs: normalize guide path casing + escape example paths

PR summary: "Normalize case for guides links to avoid CI mkdocs 404 on linux; wrap example paths in backticks; add linkcheck case test."

elaine: tagging reviewers @matt @sophia. I'll also add a short note to the docs backlog to run a repo-wide check before releases.

matt: reviewed and left 1 small comment about preserving a display name that intentionally had titlecase in a user-facing sentence (not a link). otherwise LGTM :shipit:

sophia: lgtm, but please run the sed one-liner on a branch first and push so we can see diffs.

deploy-bot: build 3346 passed — docs site built successfully :white_check_mark:

matt: awesome — thanks both. I'll merge once CI green and then cut the patch release notes: "docs: fix mkdocs linkcase causing CI warnings"

elaine: merged and backported to stable. added entry to changelog under docs fixes.

sophia: nice! will run quick grep for other capitalized path segments and open follow-ups if any. :mag:
